description: Potenzialflächen der Flächenanalyse Windenergie NRW (LANUK 2023) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Dargestellt werden Potenzialflächen in zwei Varianten aus der Flächenanalyse Windenergie NRW des LANUK (2023). Dies beinhaltet Potenzialflächen für die Windenergienutzung sowie Potenzialflächen inklusive zusätzliche Flächenpotenziale in den naturschutzrechtlich nicht streng geschützten Teilflächen der Bereiche zum Schutz der Natur (BSN). Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are energieatlas, energiequellen, energiewende, energy, erneuerbare-energien. It offers 2 resource(s) in DOWNLOAD, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
